items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: Just like Professor Long, you had to study it to play it.

ctx.x: No, not Barts. If you call the name, I don't know. But anyway, and when he was having this thing about five years ago, I played out there. I did this thing with this white band. And the drummer, and I told him about it. I said, man, that's Hungry. He said, I can play it. And sure enough, when I went to rehearsal, he played it. You know, very few drummers can play like Hungry. Because he was very unorthodox. He did everything on the other side. Just like Professor Long, you had to study it to play it. And he…
